title: jmap-server: language argument on /get and dispatcher gating for i18n
description:
jmap-server: `language` on /get, plus the dispatcher gating.
- Gating, per the decision from child .1:
  - `language` without i18n in `using`, or for an account without I18nAccountCapability: invalidArguments.
  - `locale` or `localizations` in /set: invalidProperties.
- handle_get / handle_get_with_metadata (handlers.rs:168, :249): parse `language` as LanguageRange[]|null. When it is set and O: Localizable, apply jmap_types::i18n::lookup + localized_view to each serialized item before the `properties` filter. `state` is unchanged.
- Data never varies with Accept-Language. Document in the rustdoc that consumers MUST NOT let Accept-Language reach get_objects/query_objects for localizable properties (draft: MUST NOT, state-keyed caches).
- Types that are not Localizable reject `language` with invalidArguments.
Tests: language view, no language, the non-capable account, and properties filtering combined with language.
notes:
Design: docs/design/updates.md (final 2026-11-15, decisions 27-31). JmapBackend::i18n_info(caller, account) -> Option<I18nInfo> (default None) gates the account; I18nRequest::from_args per handler on every deployment (decision 31/Q2). /get view returns localizations: null (decision 30).
Done 2026-11-15. Shape: the Localizable trait from .2 became JmapObject::LOCALIZABLE (default empty), so generic handlers see it for every type; language on a type without localizable properties is invalidArguments. handle_get (no using) treats i18n as absent; types with localizable properties must use handle_get_with_metadata or I18nProjection in their own handler (Mailbox, .7). language is now rejected where it was silently ignored (CHANGELOG Changed).
close_reason: language on /get: JmapBackend::i18n_info, I18nProjection, handle_get/handle_get_with_metadata gating and view; 9 integration tests
